title: Yoisaki Kanade — Brand New Style〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
(This chord still doesn't seem right...
But it's technically the sound I'm looking for...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Maybe I should try playing this song again from the beginning.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Hm? Someone just logged it...
Oh, it's Mizuki.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<Hello? Amia...?
I thought you said you'd be at school today.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <I did go. But only until noon♪>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <My teacher and classmates were so surprised when they saw me there this morning.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <But the person sitting in front of me wasn't surprised at all.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <No way. There was a class that I thought I needed to attend this morning.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <I'm also trying to stay on top of my attendance from the get-go so that I don't have to suffer through more supplementary classes.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Oh, that's right. Mizuki had to take supplementary classes in order to actually become a second-year.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <You seem to have a lot on your plate...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <A little. Fortunately, my new class seems like a lot of fun, so that's a plus.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <I doubt many people expected so many interesting characters to be placed in the same class.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Oh, do you have any fun memories regarding that?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <No, I was actually trying to remember what happened... But I having trouble recalling.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Hmm... I guess that means nothing memorable happened, huh?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <You never even had that “Wow, we're in the same class again♪” conversation with someone?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <“Oh, you don't know anyone in this class too? Neither do I. I'm glad there's someone who's in the same boat...”>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <That sounds likely, but I don't remember...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Then, how about things you do remember...?! What can you recall from when you moved up a grade and stuff?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Oh, I do remember something that happened during this one opening ceremony...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <So... You're normally seated alphabetically for those, right? Because of that, I always ended up somewhere towards the back.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <I'm not very tall, so I couldn't see who was speaking on stage... I even resorted to seeing between people and jumping up and down.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Wait, what?!
No way! That's so cute!>

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Kanade
rows.Line:
Huff... Huff...
I... I still can't see...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <I don't remember trying as hard as you think I did, Amia.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Really? But trying to see between people and jumping up and down's way too cute!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Yeah!
Anyway, what else can you recall?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Oh, I should get back to work soon...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Aww, really?!
Fine, I guess I should do the same.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Still, K, thanks for telling me that.
I feel way more motivated about working now! I'm gonna do my best♪>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (That was nice since I did get a little stuck back there. Now then...)
